title: Get insurance quotes from many agencies with an agent
summary: After local brokers turned him down, a marketing-agency owner had an AI agent fill out cyber insurance quote forms; he says one agency called within a minute and he was covered that day.
agent_role: The agent submitted the owner's details to multiple agency quote forms; the owner then spoke with the responding agency and an underwriter.
outcome: Author reports most agencies never called, one called within a minute, and he had coverage by the end of the day.
what_they_did: The author runs a small, mostly remote marketing agency. He needed tech and cyber insurance after local brokers turned him down. He had an AI agent fill in quote forms at several insurance agencies. He then took the calls himself and shared his screen with an underwriter.
how_it_went: He says most agencies never called. One called within a minute and followed up 20 minutes later. He had coverage by the end of the day.
worth_knowing: The agent asked for the wrong product. The underwriter found he had accidentally requested directors and officers coverage he didn't need. Check what the agent submits.
prompt: I need a quote for [type of insurance, e.g. tech and cyber liability] for my business, [business description, size, location]. Find [number] reputable agencies or carriers that offer this coverage for businesses like mine and list them with links. Then draft the information you'd submit on each quote form, showing exactly which coverage types you'll select. Wait for my approval before submitting any form, and don't apply for any coverage I haven't confirmed. Afterwards, give me a tracker of where you submitted and any responses.

curation.rationale: A real case of an agent filling out business insurance quote forms across agencies leading to same-day coverage, but the post is mostly sales advice for agents and gives no tool or setup details.
